Transaction 4012178 originated from a previously unseen device (Samsung SM-G973F map400 Playlist for Android) and an anonymous proxy IP located in Argentina, both consistent with card-not-present fraud [EV-d6a20171, EV-30b53252]. The customer confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and retained physical possession of the card [EV-508e977c]. Historical analysis revealed one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4322) associated with this customer/card and the same device profile appearing in another confirmed fraud case [EV-17323360, EV-33d48d97]. Pattern retrieval identified six prior closed cases sharing the card_not_present_new_device pattern, supporting the classification [EV-85170f1c]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict and the case was closed with total exposure of $2,005.89. No further action is recommended beyond standard recovery procedures.
